system.description: Starting at 14th level, when you summon a Duplicity, as part of the same action, the Duplicity transforms its outward appearances to match that of another hostile creature you can see in initiative. While in this appearance, if there are 2 or more hostile creatures in initiative, they are always weary and no longer treat their allies who share appearances with the Duplicity as their ally until the Duplicity is dismissed. Each time the Duplicity is targeted by an attack or jutsu while it is within 5 feet of the creature whose appearance it stole, the casting or attacking creature must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your Genjutsu save DC, instead targeting their ally on a failure.
